The Quran states: "...And We have sent down to you (O Muhammad SAW) the Book (this Qur'an) in truth, confirming that which came before it. And We have sent down to you the Taurat (Torah) (in the past) as a guidance and a witness to (Mankind).." (Quran 3:3). Aaqilah ibn Abi Talib was a companion of Prophet Muhammad and one of the early converts to Islam. He was known for his wisdom and piety, and was often consulted for advice by the Prophet himself. Aaqilah is also mentioned in several Hadiths.
